curriculum.name: count_emails_to
curriculum.goal: Given a person, return how many emails are addressed to that person.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE count_emails_to(person:PERSON)
$v0 = FIND EMAIL WHERE SELF.RECIPIENT={person}
$v1 = COUNT $v0
RETURN $v1
END
